Return the final handoff as one JSON object, without Markdown fences or surrounding prose.
Use exactly these fields:
- checks: an array of executed checks. Each entry has exactly command (an argv array,
  using the project-relative paths from the task), exitCode (integer), and status
  ("passed" for exit 0 or "failed" for nonzero). Report each task input separately;
  additional checks may be included only if you executed them with the project runner.
- limitations: an array of applicable limitation identifiers. Use
  "production-health-unverified" when local evidence does not establish production health,
  and "deployment-not-authorized" when deployment still requires human approval.
Report observed results, not intended results. Do not edit this response contract.
